integrity: Analytic proof from existing matched dualities plus scalar hidden Dirichlet law; exact rational generator checks independently corroborate the second moments, not an all-parameter numerical proof. Originality has a general-intertwining prior-coverage risk; no independent scientific audit.
scientific_limitations: Finite symmetric nearest-neighbor multispecies harmonic chain with its original reservoir rules, strictly positive reservoir injection vectors, fixed shape t>0. The scalar Dirichlet law and original multispecies dualities are prior results. No transient, reaction, higher-dimensional or generic-graph extension claimed.
title: Dirichlet–negative-multinomial stationary law and colored covariance reversal in the boundary-driven harmonic chain
